credentials.notes: Uses Clerk auth - must be logged in via existing session

sessions.title: Folder sidebar renders on documents page
steps: Navigate to documents page
Verify folder sidebar panel is visible on the left
Verify 'All Documents' root item is shown and active
Verify 'New Folder' button is present
Verify resizable handle is present between sidebar and content
sessions.notes: All elements present: All Documents button (e188), New Folder button (e191), resizable separator with grip icon (e192/e194)

sessions.title: Create folder on documents page
steps: Click 'New Folder' button
Type a folder name and press Enter
Verify folder appears in sidebar
Create a second folder to verify multiple folders work
Verify folders are sorted alphabetically
sessions.notes: Created 'Contracts' and 'Agreements'. Toast shown. Alphabetical sort confirmed (Agreements before Contracts).

sessions.title: Create nested folder
steps: Click on an existing folder to select it
Click 'New Folder' button (should create inside selected folder)
Verify child folder appears nested under parent
Verify expand/collapse chevron appears on parent
Click chevron to collapse/expand

bugs.description: New Folder button always creates at root level — createFolder mutation never passed parentId (activeFolderId). Fixed: pass activeFolderId as parentId.

Clicking folder chevron expands but doesn't select (navigate) because stopPropagation prevents outer button onClick. Fixed: chevron handler now also calls onFolderSelect, and handleClick also expands.

sessions.notes: 2 bugs found and fixed. Re-tested after fix — nested folder creation and expand/collapse all working.

sessions.title: Folder navigation and filtering
steps: Click on a folder - verify URL updates with folderId param
Verify document list filters to show only docs in that folder
Verify breadcrumbs appear showing folder path
Click breadcrumb to navigate back to parent/root
Click 'All Documents' to return to root view
sessions.notes: URL updates with ?folderId=xxx. Empty folder shows 'No documents yet'. Breadcrumbs show path. Both breadcrumb and sidebar All Documents navigate back to root.

sessions.title: Folder context menu - rename and pin
steps: Right-click a folder to open context menu
Click 'Rename' - verify inline edit appears
Type new name and press Enter - verify name updates
Right-click again, click 'Pin' - verify pin indicator appears
Verify pinned folder sorts to top of list
sessions.notes: Renamed 'Agreements' to 'Legal Agreements'. Pinned it — pin icon appears, sorts to top above 'Contracts'.

sessions.title: Folder context menu - visibility and delete
steps: Right-click a folder, change visibility to 'Admin Only'
Verify visibility change persists (reload page)
Right-click a folder (one with no docs), click 'Delete'
Verify AlertDialog confirmation appears
Confirm delete - verify folder removed from sidebar
sessions.notes: Visibility changed to Admin Only, persisted after reload (menu shows 'Set Visible to Everyone'). Delete with AlertDialog confirmed. Folder removed.

sessions.title: Move document to folder
steps: Find a document in the list with action menu
Click 'Move to folder' option in document actions
Verify MoveToFolderDialog opens with folder tree
Select a folder and click 'Move'
Verify document disappears from current view and appears in target folder

bugs.description: MoveToFolderDialog has nested <button> inside <button> (chevron inside folder row) causing React warning. Fixed: changed inner <button> to <span role='button' tabIndex={-1}>.

sessions.notes: Move dialog works. Document moved from root to Contracts folder. Appears in Contracts view. Minor HTML nesting warning (button in button).

sessions.title: Templates page folder sidebar
steps: Navigate to templates page
Verify folder sidebar is present (type='template')
Create a template folder
Verify it appears in sidebar
Verify 'All Templates' root item works
sessions.notes: Templates page has folder sidebar with All Templates + New Folder. Created 'NDA Templates' folder — appeared in sidebar. URL updates with folderId when folder selected. All Templates returns to root.

sessions.title: Delete folder with contents
steps: Move a document into a folder (if not already done)
Delete the folder via context menu
Verify confirmation dialog warns about contents
Confirm deletion
Verify document is orphaned back to root (appears in All Documents)
sessions.notes: Document was already in Contracts folder (from B3). Deleted Contracts — AlertDialog warned 'All subfolders will also be deleted. Documents and templates inside will be moved to root level.' Confirmed. Folder + NDAs subfolder removed. test-agreement.pdf back in root document list.

sessions.title: Resizable panel behavior
steps: Drag resize handle to make sidebar narrower
Drag to make wider
Try to collapse sidebar completely
Verify main content area adjusts properly
Reload page and verify layout is reasonable
sessions.notes: Sidebar panel config: defaultSize=20%, minSize=15%, maxSize=35%, collapsible. Dragged narrower — sidebar collapsed to icon-only state. Content area adjusts properly to fill space. Grip handle visible. After reload, layout returns to reasonable default. Panel supports full collapse due to collapsible prop.
